posts.author: TheOGBingus
posts.body: Hello, I'm new to this website. Right now I am trying to recreate all of Earthbound in RPG Maker 2003 as a way to see what the engine can do and a way for me to learn it more. For skills, if I make something have a variance of 0, will it have no variance or will it have 5% variance as the help section for it isn't too clear on that. Thanks!

posts.author: AkiraKotatsuhime
posts.body:
Since the variance-slider maxes at 50% when set to 10 (5% per step) according to help, it should have no effect on the outcome at 0. At least that seems very clear to me, what the document really is vague about are the settings for influence coming from attacker's STR and INT.
Shouldn't last too long to run a few tests, that's what battle-test is for in troops-editing. I'd suggest you just try it out a bit and see if the dealed damage stays the same when everything else is constant.
～炬燵あ
